description:
Operating Area: France, Corsica, Sardinia, Italy, Balearic Sea

Nautor Swan shipyard, with a high-end specification from a passionate owner, built the 108-foot sailing yacht PS5 PLAYSTATION in 2023. This innovative hull is the result of precision work, quality and attention to detail, offering outstanding performance, elegant design and luxurious comfort. 

This latest Swan maxi yacht has been designed and engineer for high speed sailing in all wind and sea conditions. She offers all her guests breath-taking sensations in comfortable and safe conditions, allowing the whole family to full enjoy their charter. 

PS5 PLAYSTATION can accommodate up to 9 people on board. Her interior features a Master suite, a VIP cabin and 2 twin cabins, one with an additional pullman bed and one convertible into a double. PS5 PLAYSTATION's large saloon, bathed in light through exceptionally large potholes, invites guests to relax in a refined and intimate atmosphere. The small lounge offers a playful space for board games and film nights. PS5 PLAYSTATION's specialised dining room allows guests to enjoy high-quality meals and service onboard. The crew have their own quarters and service entrance, which maintains privacy for guests. 

On deck, PS5 PLAYSTATION has an exceptional swimming platforms, as well as spacious relaxation and dining areas, always elegant and preserving a high quality of service.

crew.name: Mathew Gander
crew.bio:
Sail and Work Experience

Matthew is a highly experienced sailing yacht captain with extensive offshore cruising, racing, and delivery experience. He has captained PS5 PLAYSTATION and KISMET, leading Mediterranean cruising programmes, Atlantic crossings, competitive regattas, and all aspects of vessel management and guest operations. Earlier roles include Mate/Deckhand aboard PARADIS, Sailing Instructor and Chief Instructor with Flying Fish, worldwide yacht deliveries totalling approximately 50,000 nautical miles, flotilla management, yacht refit projects, and competitive racing including Les Voiles de St Tropez. His background also includes engineering and project management experience from his previous career as a Physics Research Associate. 

Job Description

The Captain is responsible for navigation, safety, the overall running and financial management of the vessel, crew and guests. He ensures the safe and efficient operation of the yacht at all times, including compliance with all safety procedures and regulations. He takes care of adhering to flag regulations, port state and local laws and regulations, and manages the crew to ensure adherence to, and a full understanding of, the vessel’s policies. He provides daily leadership for the crew and encourages teamwork, individual growth and personal development.

Licences and Qualifications
•	RYA/MCA Ocean Yachtmaster (Commercially Endorsed) 
•	STCW 95 Basic Training 
•	RYA Powerboat Level 2 
•	GMDSS Long Range Radio Certificate & Satellite Endorsement 
•	RYA Cruising Instructor 
•	RYA/MCA Yachtmaster Theory Instructor 
•	MCA Approved Engineering Course 
•	PADI Open Water Diving Certificate 
•	RYA Dinghy Level 2 
Languages
English

crew.name: Michele Gallo
crew.bio:
Sail and Work Experience

Michele is a professional chef with over 20 years of culinary experience and several seasons in the yachting industry. He has worked as Sole Chef aboard NDS EVOLUTION, SAIL SPIRIT, ALEJANDRA, and CHIKKO 4, catering for owners, guests, and crew while managing provisioning, inventories, budgets, and food costs. Alongside his culinary responsibilities, he has assisted with sailing operations, watchkeeping, docking manoeuvres, and crew training. Prior to yachting, Michele held Executive Chef, Head Chef, and Sous Chef positions across Italy, Norway, Tanzania, Australia, New Zealand, and Scotland, gaining extensive experience in Mediterranean cuisine, healthy dining, kitchen management, and reducing food waste. 

Job Description

The Chef is responsible for planning and preparing high-quality meals for owners, guests, and crew while maintaining exceptional hygiene and food safety standards. They oversee provisioning, inventory, budgeting, menu planning, and galley organisation, ensuring efficient operations and accommodating dietary preferences. The Chef also maintains the galley to the highest standards and works closely with the crew to provide an outstanding onboard experience.

Licences and Qualifications
•	ENG1 
•	B1/B2 Visa 
•	STCW Basic Safety Training 
•	Food Safety & Hygiene Level 2 
•	School for Culinary Arts & Hotel Management, IPSSEOA di Soverato (5 years) 
Languages
Italian, English

crew.name: Caitlin Mahoney
crew.bio:
Sail and Work Experience

Caitlin has developed a versatile yachting background combining interior, deck, culinary, and diving responsibilities. She has worked aboard NAUTI MERMAID, MIRAGE, VALENTINE, NAUTILUS, BVI Aggressor Liveaboards, and 3 SISTERS, delivering luxury guest service, housekeeping, bartending, provisioning, cooking, watchkeeping, and assisting with sailing operations. She is also an experienced Dive Instructor, leading guest dives, tender operations, and water activities. Her hospitality background complements her ability to deliver exceptional guest experiences across both private and charter yachts. 

Job Description

The Stewardess is responsible for maintaining the yacht's interior to the highest standards, delivering exceptional guest service, housekeeping, laundry, table settings, food and beverage service, provisioning, and assisting with guest activities. Depending on operational requirements, she also supports deck operations, tender work, and water sports while ensuring guests enjoy a seamless onboard experience.

Licences and Qualifications
•	STCW 2010 
•	ENG1 Medical 
•	PADI EFR & Nitrox Instructor 
•	The Stewardess Co. Stew Course 
•	SYCA Food Health & Safety Level 2 
•	SYCA Intro to Barista Course 
•	RYA Powerboat Level 2 
•	SAMSA SRC VHF Radio 
Languages
English

crew.name: Claire Dugué
crew.bio:
Sail and Work Experience

Claire is an enthusiastic Bosun with over 13,000 logged nautical miles and experience leading deck operations aboard ALEJANDRA, where she progressed from Deckhand to Bosun. She has managed deck maintenance, watchkeeping, inventory, crew training, rig care, varnishing, painting, winch servicing, and transatlantic passages. She also gained experience aboard ADEONA and completed a delivery aboard DREAMS 3. Before entering yachting, Claire worked in business management, carpentry, and hospitality, bringing strong organisational and leadership skills to her maritime career. 

Job Description

The Bosun supervises the deck crew and is responsible for organising and maintaining all exterior operations aboard the yacht. Duties include deck maintenance, tender operations, safety equipment, mooring, anchoring, watchkeeping, inventories, supervising deck projects, and ensuring the exterior is maintained to the highest standard while assisting the First Mate and Captain.

Licences and Qualifications
•	Yachtmaster Offshore Commercially Endorsed 
•	STCW Basic Training 
•	ENG1 
•	French Deckhand Certificate 
•	STCW Security Awareness 
•	Tender Driving Licence 
•	Master's Degree in Business Management 
Languages
French, English, Spanish

crew.name: Juan Ignacio Biava
crew.bio:
Sail and Work Experience

Juan Ignacio is an electromechanical engineer with a strong sailing background and growing superyacht engineering experience. He has recently served as Sole Engineer aboard DOÑA FRANCISCA, managing hydraulic, electrical, mechanical, and preventative maintenance systems. Previous roles include Chase Boat Skipper for ARISTARCHOS, Race Crew aboard MOAT, Temporary Crew aboard ARTEMIS BLEU, and Deckhand/Second Engineer aboard PANTHALASSA, where he combined engineering duties with deck operations, sail handling, rigging, tender operations, and watchkeeping. He is also an accomplished competitive sailor, former Argentine National Team member, and experienced delivery skipper. 

Job Description

The Engineer is responsible for the operation, maintenance, and repair of all mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, plumbing, HVAC, and technical systems aboard the yacht. He carries out preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, machinery servicing, technical record keeping, spare parts management, and ensures all engineering systems operate safely and efficiently while assisting deck operations when required.

Licences and Qualifications
•	MCA AEC 2 CoC 
•	Yachtmaster Offshore CoC 
•	STCW Basic Safety Training 
•	STCW Crisis Management & Human Behaviour 
•	STCW Passenger Safety, Loading & Hull Integrity 
•	STCW Crowd Management 
•	STCW Security for Personnel in Direct Contact with Passengers 
•	RYA VHF SRC 
•	RYA PPR 
•	Seafarers STCW Medical 
•	Electromechanical Engineering Degree 
•	Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate 

Languages
Spanish, English, Italian
